title: session-load --intake-real's check compares against a case no row has, and its real row starts fewer processes than the pinned hook
goal: session-load --intake-real's spawns row note and the benchmarks doc state that the real row is the intake hook cut at its INTAKE_HOOK_BUDGET_S wait, so its spawns are not comparable with the pinned row's; intake_real_rows writes its spawns note from the module constant INTAKE_REAL_SPAWNS_NOTE
repro_reason: the defect is a check comparing against a case name no row carries; the record rows are the evidence, and a behaviour run takes about 3 minutes per arm (the reviewer's repro in the notes)
notes: Review G1: the check compares with ('idle hook intake','A','spawns'), which no row has, so it reads real > 0. Measured: real 634-644 spawns, wall 50.1 s (= INTAKE_HOOK_BUDGET_S), pinned 936-950; nothing shows an item check ran (bench_load.py:667-682). Behaviour repro: run session-load --arms A --reps 1 with and without --intake-real (a claude that exits 1 first on PATH) and compare spawns.
